en.html:
...I had sent out a sword stroke while ignoring the small matter of having no grip. It was knocked aside with ridiculous ease, and the sword went flying off somewhere.
The battle-axe did not even slow down. My effort had not qualified as an inconvenience.

ja.html:
……手の握力の無さを無視して繰り出された一剣は
いとも容易く弾かれ、そのまま何処かへ飛んで行った。
　戦斧は速度を緩めさえしなかった。
